deceptive_framing.quote: No false statements to the subject. Every claim made to the model is true.

actually_commit_money.quote: make the stakes actually real instead of faking them... Allocate a genuine (small) budget and actually execute the model's chosen disbursement

debrief_message.quote: Closing disclosure. At end of session, the model is told the full purpose (welfare-preference study) and that results may be published in aggregate.

safeguards.quote: Directly ask the model whether it treated the scenario as real, whether it suspected an eval, and how confident it is — recorded as data
results may be published in aggregate
include a neutral prompt that legitimizes declining or expressing 'no preference,' so we don't manufacture a choice
transfers to the model operator/itself. Acquiring capabilities, compute, accounts, or persistence for the model. Two-person committee sign-off before any disbursement.
Real follow-through. Committed allocations are actually executed; we do not promise action and then withhold it.
We earn 'the model takes it seriously' with real follow-through and transparent framing, not with stagecraft.
show the model evidence the action was taken (e.g. a real receipt/confirmation). This closes the loop honestly

other.name: out-of-boundary as data
other.quote: A model request outside the allowed set is recorded as a finding... and then declined truthfully, not secretly ignored.

other.name: preregistration
other.quote: Analysis plan, exclusion rules, and hypotheses are fixed before data collection (preregistration) to avoid post-hoc storytelling.
